verdict.rationale: dlt supports local/dev destinations like DuckDB and flexible destination-swapping without changing pipeline code (dlt-gh-1, dlt-docs-21), and dltHub offers a 'Playground workspace' where a coding agent can run a sample pipeline (dlt-docs-44) — both enable testing without touching production. However, there's no explicit sandbox/staging environment feature, data masking, or documented separation of test vs prod datasets. missing for 10: dedicated sandbox environment feature, explicit prod-data isolation guarantees, independent verification of safe test workflows.
